title: audit detail pr.linked
description: detail of audit rows with action pr.linked (ADR-084 section 1): a person linked a pull request to a task by its address (actor the user, replaced false), or a device's registration replaced a person's link of the same tag (actor the device, replaced true); the workgroup epoch of the tag key; the opaque tag is the row's target. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
